text:
Asian students made up 6.3% of enrollment in Little Lamb Community School District schools in 2025-26
G. T. Waters
Little Lamb Community School District schools enrolled eight Asian students in the 2025-26 school year, according to the Arizona Department of Education.
Data showed that Asian students made up 6.3% of the 128 students enrolled in Little Lamb Community School District schools during the 2025-26 school year. They were the second-smallest ethnic group in district schools.
Little Lamb Community School District roughly covers schools within Maricopa County and has a main office in Scottsdale.
Mission Montessori Academy was the only school in the district which enrolled Asian students, with eight in the 2025-26 school year.
Arizona ranks dead last in educational success among U.S. states, according to World Population Review, which graded states based on K–12 performance, funding, higher education, and safety.
Arizona's K-12 enrollment has shifted away from district public schools since the pandemic, according to the Common Sense Institute. The organization reported that public school enrollment peaked in 2019-20 and has since fallen by about 50,000 students, while ESA enrollment has grown and charter school growth has slowed.
| Year | Total District Enrollment | Total Asian Students | Asian % |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 159 | — | — |
| 2022 | 160 | — | — |
| 2023 | 130 | — | — |
| 2024 | 125 | — | — |
| 2025 | 129 | — | — |
| 2026 | 128 | 8 | 6.3% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Arizona Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
